name: level-shifter-oxide-safety
description: Cascode/clamped level shifter (spec/gate-driver.md sec4): transient thin-oxide gate-to-any-node excursion, functional correctness, and propagation delay across the full PVT matrix including the 6V stretch drive rail.
analyses: meas tran t_plh trig v(in) val=1.65 rise=1 targ v(out) val=2.5 rise=1
meas tran t_phl trig v(in) val=1.65 fall=1 targ v(out) val=2.5 fall=1
meas tran vout_hi_abs find v(out) at=59n
meas tran vout_lo_abs find v(out) at=19n
meas tran vdrv_now find v(vdd_drv) at=59n

vgate_thinox_max.description: spec sec2.3: no thin-oxide gate-to-any-node DC/transient excursion may exceed 3.63V, at any instant, any corner -- the sec4 topology's central claim.

vout_hi_ratio.description: IN held high (t=59ns, mid-pulse) -> OUT must track VDD_DRV (non-inverting, decision record 0001 Decision 3).

vout_lo_ratio.description: IN held low (t=19ns, pre-edge) -> OUT must sit near GND_DRV (non-inverting, off state).

vccomp_dev_max.description: decision record 0014: worst-case transient voltage across ANY ONE of XCCOMP1..XCCOMP4, against the gf180mcu MiM capacitor's 6V rating (gf180mcu-pdk docs/analog/model_parameters/LV/tables_clear/08_MIM.csv, which rates all three MiM densities identically at 'usable for Volt <=6V across capacitor'). The four-deep series stack exists to satisfy DRM MIMTM.8a's 25um2 minimum MIM area at a usable capacitance; dividing the stack voltage four ways is a second, independent benefit this check records.
